rows.ARS:
Apricot or apricot blend Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Clodagh McGredy
rows.Origin:
Bred by Samuel Darragh (1932-2019) McGredy IV (1991).
Introduced by Unknown (New Zealand) in 2001 as 'Clodagh McGredy'.
rows.Bloom: Apricot or apricot blend, ages to lighter . Apricot-bronze. Soft buff-amber. Bronze. Moderate fragrance. Small to medium, double (17-25 petals), ruffled bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Compact. Matte, medium green foliage.

Height: 31" to 43" (80 to 110cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Can be used for exhibition or garden. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
rows.Breeder's notes: Clodagh McGredy - Macswanle. Nicknamed Swanley. For my daughter.
rows.Notes: Named for Sam McGredy's youngest daughter

colour: Apricot or apricot blend, ages to lighter . Apricot-bronze. Soft buff-amber. Bronze.
